Chaparral geometry alternatives, 2026-11-24

The six rows in chaparral-f11-alternates-arm64.txt were generated from the
pre-retirement direct constructor at f11cfac285997b5fbad53e16509b4bff22a87e3f.
The checked profile constructor at f8ddbbbb produced the same rows byte for
byte. Both use the seeds, detail levels, geometry and material fingerprint
of the original vegetation-reference-arm64.txt record. The original Nov 9
record remains unchanged and is still accepted for those cases.

Moving twig construction between packages changes compiler inlining and
fused multiply-add evaluation. A measured twig endpoint differed by 1–2
ULP between f8 and the initial moved implementation. Explicitly retaining
fused twig endpoint arithmetic restores all 96 newly captured historical
plant records, but it also reproduces these six f11/f8 chaparral values
instead of the older recorded values. The verifier accepts exactly either
recorded digest for each of those six cases and no alternative elsewhere.

Captured on Darwin arm64 with go1.27.3, GOWORK=off and GOMAXPROCS=2 using
the historical direct plant kind and original producer (reconstructed as
described in historical-plants-provenance.txt). Source and
producer hashes are recorded in historical-plants-provenance.txt.

SHA-256:

  six alternative rows        0c673f4dad05a757670af5c1735b7772849b52a8f6ed936f9a0be36fbe49dde1
